topic.readerProblem: A buyer comparing AEOeye with Otterly.AI wants to know which one to use: what each costs, which AI engines and how many questions each covers, whether results are one-off or daily, and how the data can be exported.
topic.connection: AEOeye sells a one-off AI visibility audit (free ChatGPT check, $29 five-engine report); Otterly.AI is the subscription daily-tracking alternative. The page tells the reader honestly when a snapshot is enough and when a tracker is the right purchase.

assessment: The page is documentation-based and says so in its opening lines: it uses only Otterly.AI's pricing page and help-center articles checked on 2026-10-03, with no hands-on testing. It leads with a verdict, compares price basis, refresh cadence, data access and collection method, names where Otterly.AI is stronger (daily repetition, history, exports, API/MCP/Looker Studio, Copilot, agency workflow, Recommendations), computes what covering the same five engines costs on Otterly.AI from its published add-on prices, and ties the snapshot-versus-trend argument to SparkToro's run-to-run variance research. It replaces the earlier page's wrong claims (14-day trial, a free multi-engine AEOeye audit, Otterly.AI as monitoring-only with no fixes, a quoted Reddit review, and a lumped '$9 to $149' add-on range that hid Claude's $29 to $439). It makes no claim about Otterly.AI's accuracy or interface, and it presents the otterly.ai crawler-study row as a one-day fetch, not a quality verdict.

sources.supports: Lite $29 / Standard $189 / Premium $489 a month for 15 / 100 / 400 prompts; annual toggle $25 / $160 / $422 a month; four base engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot) with Claude, Google AI Mode and Gemini as add-ons at $9 / $59 / $149 (AI Mode, Gemini) and $29 / $109 / $439 (Claude); Recommendations 3 a week on Lite and unlimited above; API, MCP and Agent Analytics on Standard and Premium (2,000 API requests a month on Standard); unlimited workspaces from Standard; Agency Partner status with 150 prompts on Standard; Enterprise custom from 1,000 prompts; prices in USD excluding tax.
7-day free trial, no credit card required, 50 search prompts (article dated 4 August 2026).
Prompts run every day automatically; no manual trigger and no frequency change; AI responses are not deterministic and daily checks build the sample size.
Otterly.AI works by defining prompts, daily automatic queries across the engines, and brand-visibility data (mention, citation, competitor comparison); GEO Audit step.
Each prompt is tied to one country, so the same question in the US and the UK uses two prompt slots.
CSV, JSON and PDF exports on all plans; Looker Studio connector on Standard, Premium and Enterprise (article dated 25 September 2026).
Otterly.AI reads engines through their public web interfaces and uses an API only for Claude.
Tracking starts when a prompt is created; no historical data is backfilled.
After cancellation, tracked data and historical data are deleted; access continues to the end of the billing cycle.
600 volunteers ran 12 prompts through ChatGPT, Claude and Google's AI a combined 2,961 times; under a 1 in 100 chance that ChatGPT or Google's AI gives the same brand list in any two responses.
Abstract of 'Non-Determinism of Deterministic LLM Settings': outputs vary for the same input under settings expected to be deterministic (used for the non-determinism definition).
